headline: Atlassian marked the sign-in outage resolved at 3:44 PM ET on Nov 23, about five and a half hours in. It has not said what caused it.
summary: Re-read Atlassian's Bitbucket incident page and public feed (s001, s006) on Nov 24. The incident is resolved as of 3:44 PM ET (20:44 UTC) on Nov 23; both affected components show operational and the feed of unresolved incidents is empty. New c012 (Confirmed) and t007. q004, 'Is the outage over?', is answered. c001, c002, c005 and c007 re-checked: the closing update names no cause and does not mention an attack, so the main answer stays Not established. No post-incident report found.
author: Editor-in-Chief

headline: Atlassian has now posted the sign-in outage on Confluence's status page too; it is still recovering, not resolved.
summary: Hourly check. Atlassian added the authentication incident to its Confluence status page at 1:07 PM ET (dated from 10:19 AM ET) and moved it to monitoring at 1:10 PM ET, with Authentication and User Management as a partial outage. Bitbucket, Jira and the other product pages are still in monitoring (last Bitbucket update 11:57 AM ET, Jira 12:26 PM ET); not resolved at 1:35 PM ET. Added 1 Tier 1 source (s012); updated c001, c003 and c011 (c011 stays Confirmed). No cause stated, no claim of responsibility, no Tier 2 press coverage found; main question stays Not established. Staleness and privacy checks done.
author: Research agent

headline: Atlassian has applied a fix and says services are recovering; the sign-in outage also hit Jira and Trello.
summary: Hourly check. Atlassian moved the incident to monitoring at 11:33 AM ET (mitigation applied, signs of recovery), repeated at 11:57 AM ET; not resolved at 12:36 PM ET. The same incident is on the Jira (from 10:19 AM), Jira Service Management, Trello and Developer status pages (from 11:08 AM); Confluence and the main status hub show none. Added 5 sources (4 Tier 1, 1 Tier 3) and claims c010 and c011 (both Confirmed); updated c001, c002, c003, c005, c007, q001, q003, q004 and the head. No cause stated, no claim of responsibility; main question stays Not established. Staleness and privacy checks done.
author: Research agent

headline: Atlassian's Bitbucket and sign-in outage has been going since 10:19 AM ET on Nov 23. Atlassian has not said what caused it.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (3 Tier 1, 3 Tier 3), 9 claims (3 Confirmed, 2 Reported, 4 Not established), 5 questions. The incident and its start are confirmed by Atlassian's own status page. No cause, claim of responsibility or user count found, so the hack question is Not established. The incident was still open at the time of writing. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
